value.name: Vanguard
value.flavor: {name} holds the line so everyone standing behind it doesn't have to.

features.name: Shield Wall
features.description: As a bonus action, the {name} can raise its guard, gaining +2 AC until the start of its next turn.

features.name: Bulwark Stance
features.description: While the {name} isn't incapacitated, any ally within 5 feet of it gains +1 to AC.

features.name: Unshaken
features.description: The {name} has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

features.name: Retaliation
features.description: When a creature within 5 feet hits the {name} with a melee attack, the {name} can use its reaction to make one melee weapon attack against that creature.

features.name: Immovable Object
features.description: The {name} can't be moved against its will by any effect, and its speed can't be reduced below half.

features.name: Last Line
features.description: Once per long rest, when reduced to 0 hit points, the {name} instead drops to 1 hit point.

subclasses.name: Oath of the Wall
subclasses.flavor: A vow to be the last thing standing between danger and everyone else.

features.name: Taunting Strike
features.description: On a hit, the {name} can force the target to have disadvantage on attacks against anyone but it until the {name}'s next turn.

features.name: Rooted Defense
features.description: The {name} can't be knocked prone while conscious.

features.name: Guardian's Reflex
features.description: The {name} can use its reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack roll against an ally within 5 feet.

subclasses.name: Path of the Breaker
subclasses.flavor: Offense as the best defense -- hit first, hit hardest.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: After the {name} reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Sundering Blow
features.description: Once per turn, on a hit, the {name} can force a Strength saving throw or knock the target prone.

features.name: Unrelenting
features.description: The {name} can't be reduced to 0 hit points by any means that would leave it exactly at 0 without also destroying the body.

value.name: Duskblade
value.flavor: {name} learned just enough of the old arts to sharpen a sword's edge and a mind alike.

features.name: Bladecraft
features.description: The {name} can channel a small measure of arcane force through its weapon, adding minor magical effects to a melee attack a limited number of times per rest.

features.name: Warded Strike
features.description: As a bonus action, the {name} can grant itself resistance to one damage type until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Blink Step
features.description: As a bonus action, the {name} can teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

features.name: Spell Parry
features.description: The {name} can use its reaction to add its proficiency bonus to a saving throw against a spell it can see being cast.

features.name: Twinned Focus
features.description: Once per turn, the {name}'s weapon attack that hits can also force the target to make a saving throw against a minor debuff.

features.name: Arcane Edge
features.description: The {name}'s weapon attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance.

subclasses.name: Way of the Silent Cut
subclasses.flavor: Magic as a whisper, not a shout -- the enemy notices only after it's over.

features.name: Unseen Approach
features.description: The {name} has advantage on the first attack roll it makes against a creature that hasn't acted yet in combat.

features.name: Muted Casting
features.description: The {name}'s minor spell-like effects produce no visible or audible sign of their source.

features.name: Vanishing Step
features.description: Once per short rest, the {name} can become invisible until the end of its next turn after making a weapon attack.

subclasses.name: Way of the Bound Flame
subclasses.flavor: The blade carries fire that never quite goes out.

features.name: Ember Edge
features.description: The {name}'s weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 fire damage.

features.name: Flare Guard
features.description: The {name} gains resistance to fire damage.

features.name: Detonating Strike
features.description: Once per long rest, the {name} can make an attack that deals extra fire damage to every creature within 5 feet of the target.

value.name: Stormcaller
value.flavor: {name} treats the world's raw forces less like danger and more like an unfinished argument.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Once per long rest, during a short rest, the {name} can recover a number of expended spell slots.

features.name: Ritual Casting
features.description: The {name} can cast certain known spells as rituals without expending a spell slot.

features.name: Focused Mind
features.description: The {name} has advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration on a spell when it takes damage.

features.name: Empowered Casting
features.description: Once per short rest, the {name} can reroll one damage die when casting a spell.

features.name: Warded Mind
features.description: The {name} gains resistance to psychic damage and advantage on saves against being charmed.

features.name: Overchannel
features.description: Once per long rest, the {name} can cast a spell of 5th level or lower without expending a spell slot, taking necrotic damage equal to twice the spell's level.

subclasses.name: Current of Storms
subclasses.flavor: Lightning and thunder answer first, questions come later.

features.name: Storm's Favor
features.description: The {name}'s lightning and thunder spells deal extra damage equal to its spellcasting ability modifier.

features.name: Gale Step
features.description: As a bonus action, the {name} can move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Eye of the Storm
features.description: The {name} gains resistance to lightning and thunder damage.

subclasses.name: Current of Embers
subclasses.flavor: A slow, patient burn -- the kind of fire that outlasts the fight.

features.name: Smoldering Mark
features.description: A creature damaged by the {name}'s fire spells takes an extra 1d4 fire damage at the start of its next turn.

features.name: Cinder Ward
features.description: The {name} gains resistance to fire damage.

features.name: Wildfire
features.description: Once per long rest, the {name} can cause one of its fire spells to spread to every creature within 10 feet of its original target.

value.name: Warden
value.flavor: {name} swore an oath to something worth protecting, and hasn't found a reason to stop yet.

features.name: Guarded Vow
features.description: As a bonus action, the {name} can mark a creature within 30 feet; while marked, the {name} has advantage on attacks against any creature that damages that ally.

features.name: Steady Hand
features.description: The {name} can touch a creature to remove one disease or neutralize one poison affecting it, once per long rest.

features.name: Radiant Smite
features.description: Once per turn on a hit, the {name} can expend a spell slot to deal extra radiant damage.

features.name: Aura of Resolve
features.description: The {name} and allies within 10 feet have advantage on saves against being frightened.

features.name: Unbreakable Vow
features.description: The {name} has advantage on death saving throws.

features.name: Sanctified Ground
features.description: Once per long rest, the {name} can create a 15-foot radius where allies gain resistance to necrotic and radiant damage for 1 minute.

subclasses.name: Charge of Mercy
subclasses.flavor: The oath is to heal what the world keeps breaking.

features.name: Healing Hands
features.description: The {name} can use a bonus action to restore a small amount of hit points to a creature within 5 feet, a number of times per long rest.

features.name: Ease Suffering
features.description: The {name}'s healing spells restore additional hit points.

features.name: Ward Against Death
features.description: Once per long rest, the {name} can prevent a creature within 30 feet from dropping below 1 hit point.

subclasses.name: Charge of Ruin
subclasses.flavor: The oath is to end what shouldn't have started.

features.name: Zealous Strike
features.description: Once per turn on a hit against a creature that has damaged an ally this round, the {name} deals extra damage.

features.name: Grim Resolve
features.description: The {name} gains temporary hit points whenever it reduces a creature to 0 hit points.

features.name: Executioner's Vow
features.description: Once per long rest, the {name} can declare a target; attacks against that target score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 until the target dies or the {name} finishes a rest.

value.name: Pactbound
value.flavor: {name} made a deal that seemed reasonable at the time, and hasn't fully read the fine print since.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.description: The {name} regains its spent spell slots on a short rest, unlike most other casters.

features.name: Patron's Gift
features.description: The {name} gains a minor supernatural benefit tied to its patron, usable a limited number of times per rest.

features.name: Beguiling Word
features.description: The {name} can expend a spell slot as a bonus action to impose disadvantage on a creature's next attack roll.

features.name: Dark Bargain
features.description: The {name} can take on a temporary debuff to regain one expended spell slot, once per long rest.

features.name: Warded Pact
features.description: The {name} gains resistance to one damage type tied to its patron's nature.

features.name: Patron's Voice
features.description: Once per long rest, the {name} can call on its patron for a moment of insight, learning whether a course of action would violate its pact.

subclasses.name: Pact of the Silent Deep
subclasses.flavor: The patron speaks in pressure and pauses, not words.

features.name: Undertow
features.description: Once per turn, the {name} can force a creature it damages with a spell to make a Strength save or be pulled 10 feet toward it.

features.name: Pressure Ward
features.description: The {name} gains resistance to cold damage.

features.name: Depths Beckon
features.description: Once per long rest, the {name} can create a zone of crushing pressure that restrains creatures failing a Strength save.

subclasses.name: Pact of the Hollow Crown
subclasses.flavor: The patron speaks like it's already won, and might be right.

features.name: Commanding Presence
features.description: The {name} can use a bonus action to force a creature to make a Wisdom save or be unable to target the {name} until the {name}'s next turn.

features.name: Regal Ward
features.description: The {name} gains resistance to psychic damage.

features.name: Court of One
features.description: Once per long rest, the {name} can summon a spectral echo of its patron's court to distract enemies within 20 feet, imposing disadvantage on their next attack rolls.

value.name: Skald
value.flavor: {name} figured out early that the right words, said the right way, do most of the work.

features.name: Inspiring Verse
features.description: As a bonus action, the {name} can grant an ally within 30 feet a bonus die to add to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: The {name} adds half its proficiency bonus to any ability check that doesn't already include it.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: The {name} can use its reaction to subtract a bonus die from an enemy's failed roll, potentially worsening the result.

features.name: Countercharm
features.description: As an action, the {name} can grant itself and allies within 30 feet advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed.

features.name: Song of Rest
features.description: Allies who rest near the {name} recover extra hit points during a short rest.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: The {name} can learn one spell from any spell list, regardless of class restrictions.

subclasses.name: Tradition of the Battle Chant
subclasses.flavor: Music meant to be heard over the sound of a fight, not a fireside.

features.name: Battle Rhythm
features.description: Allies who can hear the {name} gain a bonus to initiative.

features.name: Defensive Verse
features.description: As a reaction, the {name} can grant an ally within 30 feet a bonus to AC against one attack.

features.name: Rallying Chorus
features.description: Once per long rest, the {name} can grant every ally who can hear it temporary hit points.

subclasses.name: Tradition of the Quiet Word
subclasses.flavor: Fewer notes, more precision -- the kind of performer who only needs one line to land.

features.name: Sharpened Wit
features.description: The {name}'s spells that force a saving throw are harder to resist against creatures the {name} has observed for at least a minute.

features.name: Unassuming
features.description: The {name} has advantage on Charisma (Deception) and (Persuasion) checks against creatures unaware of its true capability.

features.name: Perfect Line
features.description: Once per long rest, the {name} can guarantee one Charisma-based check succeeds without needing to roll.

designNotes.value: Procedurally rolled from a fixed archetype pool -- worth a manual pass to sand down feature wording before running it at the table.
